text: Carter Care Clinic routes 100% of its payouts into a single account, which is the only strong signal on an otherwise ordinary profile: 52 claims, one doctor, a 14.6-year-old registration, referrals spread across many brokers, and mostly one-journey patients at rates normal for medical tourism. A single corporate payout account is common bookkeeping, which is why this alert sits in the low band rather than higher. The aged registration in particular argues against a paper entity. This is a watch-list item, not a case: it becomes interesting only if the payout account also serves other flagged entities. Next step: check whether that account appears in any other alert's money trail.
